title: Ask MAIN to use agy (Antigravity) for a small job, then a follow-up in the same session
persona: A developer who likes trying Google's Antigravity. Short phone messages; calls it simply 'agy'.
goals: Have the agy agent (Antigravity, not the default builder) write a python module in a folder named agy-words that counts the words in a text file, with a pytest test.
Then, as a follow-up to the same agy session, ask it to add an option that returns only the N most frequent words.
Get confirmation that all tests pass.
script: Ask main to give the word-count job to agy, in your own short words.
Wait for main to come back with the result.
Send the top-N follow-up (it should go to the same agy session).
Ask whether all tests pass, then finish.

checks.name: agy-words tests pass
checks.cmd: cd agy-words && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out

checks.name: an agy session did the work
follow-up reused the session (<=1 under main)
